answer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co pass lease equity (the amount by which our offer exceeds the lease buyout) to the customer. Bluewater Leasing doesn't; it applies the equity to the car the customer buys from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all. Since February 1, 2026, Apex adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount, which reduces the equity the customer receives.
